description: We are a team of four curious and creative minds united by our passion for science, innovation, and space exploration. Together, we aim to think beyond boundaries, solve challenges, and explore the unknown. With teamwork, determination, and imagination, we are ready to reach for the stars and turn our ideas into reality.
summary:
NASA's discarded Mars equipment represents more than abandoned technology. It represents human ambition, scientific achievement and the determination to explore the unknown. Spirit, Opportunity and other robotic explorers may no longer be active, but their discoveries remain valuable. Their physical presence on Mars reminds us that even when an explorer falls silent, its legacy does not disappear.

Main slogan:

"They may be forgotten by time, but never by the history of exploration."
details: Since the 1960s, NASA has left hardware across the solar system–on the Moon, on Mars, and in deep space. From rovers and instruments that completed their science missions to probes still traveling away from Earth this hardware varies widely in both its purpose and current level of functionality. Your challenge is to tell the story of some or all of this equipment that introduces school-age space enthusiasts to the hardware and the science it made possible.
